stateOfPlay: Eisenkot's Yashar leads Likud 23 to 20, and both blocs have slipped: the Netanyahu bloc sits at 52, the change bloc at 51. Neither is close on its own. The change bloc plus Ra'am reaches only 57 — the arithmetic now works exactly once, if Yoaz Hendel's Reservists join too, and that lands on 61 with nothing to spare. Hendel has ruled out sitting with Shas and UTJ over the draft, and has been cool on relying on Ra'am, which makes the one available government also the one that asks the most of him. Two new parties are pulling at the right: Ofer Winter's Amcha Yisrael on four seats, and the Reservists' merger with Yaron Zelekha's New Economic Party.
